Jan Frylinck: It's obviously a very big occasion. We're all looking forward to it. I mean, it's been a while since we've played against a full member, or test nation in the ODI. Smit to Corbin Bosch, SIX, full toss again and sixer again! Corbin Bosch had a gala time towards the end. Changed his stance, went for the reverse, stayed low and tonked it flat over deep backward square. SA end with 348

13:14 Local Time, 11:14 GMT, 16:44 IST: SA have ended with 348! This is a massive total. Hermann got off to a quiet start. Saw off the movement and then went for the shots. Him and Tony played the gaps and scored quickly. They added 190 runs for the second wicket and set up the base for this tall score. Towards the end Corbin Bosch also added some meaty runs and that too quickly to take SA close to 350. For Namibia, Trumpelmann picked up four wickets but didn't get much support from his other bowlers and also the fielding was very sloppy. We will be back in 25 minutes for the chase.
